facts.text: The hotel sits in the heart of downtown Santa Barbara, between the Santa Ynez Mountains and the ocean.
facts.excerpt: Kimpton Canary Hotel sits in the heart of downtown Santa Barbara, between the Santa Ynez Mountains and the ocean.

facts.text: Guests can stroll vintage shops and cafes on State Street or tour tasting rooms on the Urban Wine Trail.
facts.excerpt: Stroll vintage shops and cafes on State Street or tour tasting rooms on the Urban Wine Trail

facts.text: The rooftop pool terrace has 360-degree views stretching from the mountains to the sea.
facts.excerpt: Pair our 360-degree rooftop views stretching from the mountains to the sea with craft cocktails, a chef-driven menu and a cush-and-cozy fireplace.

facts.text: Finch & Fork serves a coastal California menu built around the bounty of Santa Barbara.
facts.excerpt: Clean, simple coastal California menu built around the bounty of Santa Barbara.

facts.text: The Finch & Fork menu features oysters, diver scallops and King salmon.
facts.excerpt: succulent oysters, diver scallops, and the buttery flavor of King salmon

facts.text: Finch & Fork Lounge serves playful interpretations of classic cocktails.
Guest rooms have four-poster canopy beds, down duvets and Italian Frette linens.
facts.excerpt: Appointed with four-poster canopy beds, down duvets, and Italian Frette linens

facts.text: Guests can choose a room with a private balcony or a specialty suite.
facts.excerpt: Opt for a room with a private balcony or a specialty suite

facts.text: Pets are welcome regardless of size, weight or breed, at no extra charge.
facts.excerpt: We invite you to bring your pet no matter their size, weight, or breed, all at no extra charge.

facts.text: The hotel provides complimentary pet bowls and beds.
The hotel lists a complimentary wine hour, rental bikes, and a yoga mat in each room.
facts.excerpt: With thoughtful perks like a complimentary wine hour, rental bikes, and a yoga mat in each room

facts.text: There is no local area shuttle at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: There is no local area shuttle available at this hotel.

facts.text: Overnight valet parking costs $55 per night.
facts.excerpt: Kimpton Canary Hotel offers overnight valet parking services for $55 per night.

facts.text: The Funk Zone is a set of walkable blocks with art galleries, tasting rooms, boutique shops and fine foods.
facts.excerpt: Several walkable blocks encompassing art galleries, tasting rooms, boutique shops and fine foods.
